newsitem.title: USA: Saudi ups Dec light crude to Asia, Arab Heavy cut.
newsitem.headline: Saudi ups Dec light crude to Asia, Arab Heavy cut.

text.p: Saudi Arabia raised prices for December light crudes to Asian customers, but cut the price it charges for Arab Heavy, U.S. trade sources said.
The price for Berri Extra Light was raised 30 cents to the average of Oman and Dubai plus $1.85 a barrel, and Arab Light was raised 15 cents to Oman/Dubai plus 75 cents a barrel.
Arab Medium was left unchanged at Oman/Dubai minus 30 cents a barrel, and Arab Heavy was cut 10 cents to Oman/Dubai minus $1.15 a barrel, traders said.
